pairs.current:
default: "0"
      compile_cap_minutes:
        description: "Native compile slice cap in minutes: 0 keeps the reviewed 180, or 30-180 to seal a checkpoint early"
        type: string
        required: false
        default: "0"

- name: Start detached off-box runner telemetry sampler
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          if ($env:CEF_FULLSDK_COMPILE_CAP_MINUTES -cnotmatch '^(?:0|[3-9][0-9]|1[0-7][0-9]|180)$') { throw 'FULL_SDK_COMPILE_CAP_INPUT' }
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
          & gh api "repos/$env:GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/ref/heads/ci-telemetry" *> $null
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { & gh api -X POST "repos/$env:GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs" -f ref=refs/heads/ci-telemetry -f sha=$env:GITHUB_SHA *> $null }
          $global:LASTEXITCODE = 0
          Start-Process -FilePath pwsh -WindowStyle Hidden -ArgumentList '-NoProfile', '-File', (Join-Path $env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE 'native/windows-arm-full-sdk/winarm-telemetry.ps1'), '-LogDir', 'C:\sorng-telemetry'
          Write-Host "::notice::telemetry sampler started (branch ci-telemetry, telemetry/winarm/$env:GITHUB_RUN_ID-$env:GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT/)"
      - name: Authenticate and download exact prior successful checkpoint
pairs.previous: - name: Authenticate and download exact prior successful checkpoint

pairs.current:
- name: Retain runner telemetry samples
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: windows-arm-full-sdk-telemetry-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7
          path: C:/sorng-telemetry/telemetry.log
      - name: Retain bounded qualification records
